item_name: Total Severity Score (Staff Assessment of Resident Mood, PHQ-9-OV©)
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND for D0600 itself: the D0600 pages (p. D-16, p. D-17) do not state an observation window for this item. Related context on other pages: the D0500 Steps for Assessment state 'Conduct the interviews during the 7-day look-back period based on the ARD' (p. D-13), while D0500 symptom frequency is rated over the past 2 weeks (p. D-15); the D0600 interpretation text refers to symptoms 'during the look-back period' without defining a number of days (p. D-17). No lookback is asserted for D0600 here.

coding_levels.label: Total Severity Score (two-digit sum of D0500 Column 2 frequency responses)
coding_levels.definition: Sum of the scores for all frequency responses in D0500 Column 2, Symptom Frequency; the total score must be between 00 and 30.

source.quote: Add scores for all frequency responses in Column 2, Symptom Frequency. Total score must be between 00 and 30.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Add the scores for all frequency responses in D0500 Column 2, Symptom Frequency; the total score must be between 00 and 30.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Complete D0600 after completing the Staff Assessment of Resident Mood by adding the numeric scores across all frequency items for Staff Assessment of Mood, Symptom Frequency (D0500) Column 2.

source.quote: Add the numeric scores across all frequency items for Staff Assessment of Mood, Symptom Frequency (D0500) Column 2.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The interview is considered successfully completed if the staff members were able to answer the frequency responses of at least 8 out of 10 items on the PHQ-9-OV©.
